sections.text:
Return Relay and Associated Equipment to 
Service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( A2 - A3 ) , ( A6 - A7 
 ) , ( A10 - A11 ) 
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact ( A4 - A5 ).

Make sure CT and PT secondary circuits 
 are in normal condition.

If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.

text:
Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This
document outlines the testing procedure P1, which must be carried on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block,
The micro-processor controlled relays of the MCX912 provides a large number 
 of protection functions, This relay can be used to replace several 
 conventional relays.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin Hamdy & 
eng. Azza Salama at 29 April 2003, revised by Quality Control eng. Adel El-Nagar at EDEP Co., accepted by General Director 
eng. Mahmoud Saker, and approved by eng. Moustfa 
Alam Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Make sure that the the pump mechanically and electrically isolated.
Switch off DC
power supply before inserting or withdrawing any card from the relay.
Switch off the AC power supply of the motor.
Tools and Equipment
Secondary injection test.
Test leads, and test plug handle.
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make Sure CT secondary circuit are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolating the relay current circuit for test
Obtain copy of relay setting from 
 field maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay.
Testing the Relay
Connect the test leads between the current terminals ( A2 A3 ) phase R. 
 (figure 1)
Connect the test leads between the trip contact ( A4 A5 )
Increase the current slowly until the relay trips
Record the current value and the time value at which the relay trips in the 
 test sheet .
Connect the test leads between the current terminal ( A6 A7 ) phase S. 
 (figure 1)
Increase the current very slow until the relay trips .
Record the current and the time values in the test sheet .
Change the negative sequence time to 10 sec.
Increase the current until the relay trips
Record the current and the time values in the test sheet .
Record the current and the time values in the test sheet .
Increase the current to the S.C setting until the relay trips
Record the current and the time values in the test sheet .
Increase the current to a large value until the relay trips
Record both current and the time values in the test sheet .
Return Relay and Associated Equipment to 
Service
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( A2 - A3 ) , ( A6 - A7 
 ) , ( A10 - A11 ) 
 - Disconnect the test leads between the trip contact ( A4 - A5 ).
Make sure CT and PT secondary circuits 
 are in normal condition.
If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.
